v2_claim_boundary.emitter_recognition_scope: resolved canonical ordinary-admission K2 or K3 only; K1, K4-K7, unknown/ambiguous derivation, non-canonical, and extraordinary paths refuse
v2_claim_boundary.availability_condition: The availability axis is established only when the signed certificate claims it, the named verifier contract supports it, the manifest status is verified, at least one payload is present, retention is not ephemeral-until-ACK, every payload hash/length is recomputed, and declared copy/failure-domain minima are met.
v2_claim_boundary.signer_trust_boundary: The verifier independently establishes signature integrity for the signer identity it returns. The bundle-carried issuer expectation is not an external authority root and therefore does not establish authority admission, currentness, or revocation status; a relying party must pin or resolve that signer outside this integrity-only claim.
v2_claim_boundary.predecessor_rule: The immediate predecessor body and embedded signature are recomputed; domain, authority and revocation epochs, operation/receipt ranges, state commitment, and canonical head must be contiguous. Authority change is refused because no admitted-cutover proof exists.
